decision: accept grouped independent-origin evaluation at outer batch32; training remains batch64
decision_scope: Numerical implementation equivalence, not a forecasting-performance or significance result; decided before full optimized training and test evaluation
additional_requirements: finite outputs; exact training losses/gradients; identical tested FFT top-k membership and rank
TF32: disabled for matmul and cuDNN in both runner and diagnostic
interpretation: Batch1 outputs are exact. Grouped CUDA differences start in finer-scale block outputs, with exact coarse FFT inputs/scores/selections; consistent with batch-shape-dependent float32 kernel roundoff. The fitted forecast RMS-relative discrepancy is about0.00295%, and maximum discrepancy is0.00617basispoints. This is not a bitwise-CUDA-equivalence claim or a guarantee for every possible input.
rationale: Retain raw-return tolerance0.01basispoint as the primary observable-unit criterion, add normalized maximum and RMS-relative guards1e-4; the original2e-5 normalized guard was more restrictive than this documented implementation-agreement criterion. No model hyperparameter, data split, fitting objective, calibration rule or test outcome informed this numerical decision.
